### New look

- The settings window is rebuilt around six tabs: Games, Social, Performance, FastFlags, Capture and Settings
- Game pages with servers, places, private servers and friends in one view, each with its own search
- Theme studio: page card colour and opacity, panel colour, live preview, and a Reset button for unsaved changes
- Right click any setting to copy a link that opens it on someone else's PC

### Party

- Hand the party to someone else, and they accept or decline
- Remove a member as leader
- Choose what happens when the leader leaves: the longest member takes over, or the party ends
- See which game each member is in and join them from the member menu

### Games and servers

- Region, uptime and frame rate for public servers, shared between PhasmaStrap users
- Player and server counts per place
- Pick a region from the tray while you play
- Server uptime in the server information window

### Staying connected

- Rejoin the same server on its own after your connection drops or you are kicked for being idle
- Soft Key for clean direction changes, with WASD, AZERTY, ESDF and arrow key layouts

### FastFlags

- Plain names and one line descriptions for 248 flags in the editor
- Clean list checks your flags against the ones Roblox still accepts
- Turn off Roblox's own recorder

### Roblox itself

- Stay on any Roblox version by its hash
- Choose whether the Roblox app runs in the background and which theme it uses

### Accounts

- Sign in to Roblox with a code from another device
- Bring your settings over from Bloxstrap, Fishstrap and other launchers
- Friends show how long you have been friends
- A public profile on phasmastrap.com with what you published, which you can hide from your account page
- Beta update channel
- Optional crash reports, off unless you turn them on

### Appearance

- Rotate through your themes on a timer

### Fixes

- Disable RobloxCrashHandler closes it now. It used to look once, too early, and give up
- Hotkeys, Soft Key and crash analysis keep working with activity tracking off
- Saving an edited clip no longer stays on "Saving" forever
- Private servers are no longer listed twice, and all of them load
- The proxy certificate no longer shows as not accepted when it is
- The background process uses far less memory in a game, about 250 MB instead of 1.5 GB
- Background processes are always named in Task Manager
- A crash in another program is no longer blamed on Roblox
- Joining a friend from the game page no longer ends in a permission error
